_comment: Base TypeScript config for ZeroBias content packages.
lib includes DOM and types is explicit because @types/node 24 stopped
injecting ambient globals implicitly — without these, Buffer, URL,
node:stream and the generic ReadableStream declarations disappear and
transpile fails across generated code and vendor SDK type definitions.
Packages with a test suite should extend @zerobias-org/context-pack-dev
instead, which adds the mocha ambient types.
